question: What is the knowability of an entity if it is not an inherent property?
premises: Knowability cannot be an inherent property of an entity.
Consciousness arises in the form of grasping an object.
This arising of consciousness occurs within consciousness itself.
inference: The knowability of an entity is nothing other than the arising of consciousness in the form of object-grasping.
plain_english: The knowability of an entity is that very arising of consciousness which takes the form of grasping an object, occurring within consciousness itself.
